description_zh: 调用该接口停止指定的规则
name: StopRule

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
parameters.description_zh:

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。

parameters.description_en: The ID of the rule that you want to stop. You can view the rule ID on the **Message Forwarding** > **Data Forwarding** page of the corresponding instance in the IoT Platform console, or call [ListRule](~~69486~~) to obtain the rule ID from the response.
